title: BrainNet Studio: A Unified Toolkit for Brain Network Construction, Intelligent Analysis, and Visualization
abstract: arXiv:2609.37956v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Brain networks characterize structural and functional relationships among brain regions and support research on cognition, brain disorders, and brain-computer interfaces. Their time-varying topology and higher-order spatiotemporal dependencies are not adequately represented by conventional static networks. Existing tools primarily focus on static connectomes and provide limited integration of dynamic network modeling with modern graph and sequence learning methods. We present BrainNet Studio, an integrated toolkit for static and dynamic brain network analysis. It provides a unified workflow encompassing network construction, feature extraction, predictive modeling, candidate biomarker identification, visualization, and assisted interpretation. translated_title: BrainNet Studio：一个用于脑网络构建、智能分析与可视化的统一工具包
translated_abstract: 脑网络刻画了脑区之间的结构与功能关系，为认知、脑疾病和脑机接口等领域的研究提供支持。脑网络具有时变拓扑结构和高阶时空依赖关系，这是传统静态网络无法充分表征的。现有工具主要聚焦于静态连接组，在将动态网络建模与现代图学习及序列学习方法相结合方面能力有限。我们提出了BrainNet Studio，一个用于静态和动态脑网络分析的集成工具包。它提供了统一的工作流程，涵盖网络构建、特征提取、预测建模、候选生物标志物识别、可视化以及辅助解释。该工具包集成了27种算法，包括深度学习、图神经网络和时空序列模型，以支持分类任务以及判别性脑区……
tldr: BrainNet Studio是一个集成了27种算法（涵盖深度学习、图神经网络和时空序列模型）的统一工具包，为静态和动态脑网络的构建、智能分析、生物标志物识别与可视化提供了一体化工作流程。
en_tdlr: BrainNet Studio is a unified toolkit integrating 27 algorithms—including deep learning, graph neural networks, and spatiotemporal sequence models—to provide an end-to-end workflow for static and dynamic brain network construction, intelligent analysis, biomarker identification, and visualization.
